issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 05 requires selecting Gemeinden in either 'Oberbayern' OR 'Niederbayern'. The solution query in solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql uses a logical AND between these two mutually exclusive values (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'), which can never be true and therefore contradicts the task specification. This makes the provided solution incorrect and may confuse students comparing their results to the reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the WHERE condition in solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql to use OR instead of AND for the regierungsbezirk check, e.g. AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Niederbayern'), so it matches the task description.
